reuse.why: Adds one shared claimBankAccount guard in link.ts that every provider's link function calls and reuses findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse and the existing sync dispatch, but the link-clearing step re-writes unlinkAccount's field reset instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: Fintegra's link handler, account-list fetch and transaction download are near-verbatim copies of the Akahu ones, and claimBankAccount copies unlinkAccount's account-reset updateAccount block.

placement.why: The one-link/closed/takeover rule sits in the accounts link module beside findOrCreateBank, and Fintegra plumbing follows the tree's per-provider layout in app.ts, sync.ts, server-config and models.

scope.why: Everything maps to the four requested steps; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: The single guard is easy to own, but each new provider adds another ~130 copied lines and the reset of a linked account now lives in two places that can drift.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies (linkFintegraAccount vs linkAkahuAccount, downloadFintegraTransactions vs downloadAkahuTransactions, fintegraAccounts vs akahuAccounts, claimBankAccount's reset vs unlinkAccount) are plain copies, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: claimBankAccount (created in this packet) gains replaceExistingLink for the takeover step and a closed-account check that applies uniformly; all six provider link functions call it, none bypass it.
